name: shallow fruit bowl
caption: A shallow fruit bowl with a wide shallow cavity and a low rim. Continuous walls rise from a sealed base; the top edge stays open. Circular walls keep an even thickness around the cavity. Overall width is 1.30 times depth; height is 0.30 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous white, light gray, dark brown color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
